messages:
Priya (Procurement): FluxLedger sent a draft SOW + credits rate card. main asks: how credits map to tokens/embeddings, rollover, and invoice detail for AP parser.
Amelia (Finance): need deterministic conversion, sample invoice CSV, and pilot net-45.
Jon S (Eng Ops): POC used ~1.2M inference tokens + 42k embeddings. how to map w/ long-context?
Maya - FluxLedger: baseline: 1 credit = 1k inference tokens OR 10 embedding units. we apply a per-request multiplier for contexts >1024 (2x) and >4096 (3x). will share full table and example calc.
Sasha R (Platform): can you push per-request logs to our S3 w/ request_id, model, tokens_in, tokens_out, billable_credits, ts?
Maya - FluxLedger: yes — S3 or secured link. logs include billable_credits and a 'route' tag.
Priya (Procurement): rollover options? last vendor zeroed quarterly.
Maya - FluxLedger: quarterly (30% rollover) or annual (100% rollover w/ small fee). unused credits expire after 18 months.
Amelia (Finance): sample invoice lines (commit, used, overage, setup, tax) and can you support net-45 for a 3mo pilot?
Maya - FluxLedger: sample: "Commit Q1 - 150,000 credits @ $0.30 = $45,000", "Overage - 8,400 credits = $2,520", "Setup (VPC) = $5,500". net-45 ok with PO.
Jon S (Eng Ops): discounted 'background' credits for batch jobs?
Maya - FluxLedger: yes — background credits at 40% discount, tagged in logs; not for low-latency routes.
Sasha R (Platform): SOC2 + BYOK for Private?
Maya - FluxLedger: SOC2 Type II and BYOK via AWS KMS supported for Private.
Priya (Procurement): next steps: 1) Maya upload multiplier table + mock invoice CSV, 2) Accounting Bot run parser, 3) Amelia confirm net-45 budget, 4) Sasha validate BYOK & background tags. ack?
Amelia (Finance): ack — will confirm budget EOD tomorrow.
Jon S (Eng Ops): ack — will test CSV with our 1.2M token sample.
Sasha R (Platform): ack — will validate BYOK.
Maya - FluxLedger: I'll upload docs in ~40m and hold setup concession for 48h. available for brief sync. :handshake:
Accounting Bot: ready to parse upon CSV upload — will post mapping diffs in ~2hrs.
